question: Does previously learned consequence knowledge, kept at ONE persistent public address during conflicting B, improve future A/B/A scenes compared with the identical untrained algorithm and fully fitted conventional controls?
custody: Synthetic source-free research only in existing contributor PR #1327; original model untouched; canonical integration belongs only to Amalgam PR #1278. Protected first-use issue #426 NOT AUTHORIZED.
public: One address, binary selected action and step counter; no hidden initial role, regime indicator, switching timestamp or noise read by any non-oracle model.
generative: For initial private role r∈{0,1}, best arm r in A, 1-r in B, r on return. One irreversible action witness: Bernoulli p=.8 on best arm, .2 on worse arm. Exogenous deterministic hash of seed,role,step (not action), inaccessible to learners.

fit.snapshots: A after step23; B after step47; full after step71

held.action_schedule: step%2; all methods same action schedule and exogenous result sequence
held.reset: public new-world reset only: learned two-slot persistent counts retained; active slot reset to 0; recent anomaly window cleared; no hidden data supplied

candidate.label: research-only bounded numeric two-slot Beta(1,1) recurrence memory, NOT original GF2 native
candidate.training: each sequential witnessed outcome increments active slot's chosen-arm success/trial counts
candidate.surprise: Before increment: anomaly if p>=.65 and outcome0 or p<=.35 and outcome1; toggle active slot if since_switch>=8 and three anomalies within last six, retain both slots
candidate.cold: Canonical JSON + SHA256; validate source schema, integer counts, maximum bytes; exact restore
candidate.no_fit: identical empty initialized two-slot memory on each held world; explicit no-FIT ablation

controls: fully fitted stationary Beta(1,1) from same FIT 72 witnesses, counts reused held
fully fitted rolling-8 Beta(1,1) from same FIT 72 witness stream, queue reused held
fully fitted surprise reset Beta using same anomaly threshold and FIT observations
model-informed 2-state HMM with hazard 1/16, p=.8/.2 known; distinct extra structural information, reference not matched baseline
identical two-slot candidate zero-FIT ablation (not equal evidence)
primary_metric: Mean prequential held Brier on 256 outcomes, each forecast before observed result
secondary: Held known role0 vs opposite role1 prediction error
Trained minus no-FIT Brier, including harm
Same-address A slot forecasts after B, after returning to A and independent cold restoration
Whole-process CPU time, model size, typed source controls, witness counts
engineering_gate: All frozen source/controls and sequence budgets verified, cold roundtrip and fail-closed negative tests; no result-dependent PASS
science_gate: DEV_NO_GO unless original native model independently beats strongest fully trained matched equal-information controls on separately owner-admitted unfamiliar real-world first-use with old→changed→old functional retention and matched whole-process cost; impossible in this synthetic trial
exclusions: No experimental cohort rewrites or post-result tuning, no new PR/controller/scheduler, no canonical model/first-use promotion, no paid API or merge.
